MERGED. Gerrit 1934 landed on origin/main as 4e9f76a4ea at LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments.

Verified on the landed tree: det_floor.py 566, det_advisory.py 303; .github/module-size-limit.txt and .github/complexity-baseline.json byte-identical to their pre-change content; check_complexity_baseline.py --check reads active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0.

Two-sided binding check (prompted by the config.py split's late-binding regression): besides confirming nothing monkeypatches a MOVED symbol, I swept every name the moved cluster CALLS. The only import-time bindings det_advisory.py adds are vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command and _verify_command_strings — none of which is monkeypatched anywhere in the tree. Every other dependency (grounding.refute_absence, _reads.show_ticket, det_citation, det_measurement_provenance, det_operator_attested) is a lazy IN-BODY import that resolves from sys.modules at call time, so the existing monkeypatch.setattr(grounding, 'refute_absence', ...) and rebar._reads.show_ticket patches still reach the moved code. No late binding was converted to early binding by this move.

Local full-tree sweep (tests/unit + tests/interfaces + tests/scripts): 9605 passed, 42 skipped, 1 error — and that error is my own interference, a HEAD-move guard tripping because I checked out a different ref in the worktree while the run was in flight, not a defect. CI's Verified +1 ran the whole tree cleanly.
